metadata.description: RelAI — your project remembers everything. Documentation-first process framework for Claude Code.

plugins.name: relai
plugins.description: Your project remembers everything — documentation-first process framework for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex

plugins.name: relai-panel
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.295). RelAI panel: a calm bar above the prompt with the session's work (a plan stage or a thread card and its packets), its status, and a second row only while a decision card waits or the work is not chosen (then a Wybierz pracę… button opens the pane on the choice); /relai-panel opens a pane with Teraz (the work, a bar whose marks tell each item's state by shape, the whole item in the app's tooltip, the item in progress on one line, Zmień to pick the work), forms for the 16 RelAI commands, a map that starts with Ta sesja (the focus with its packets and cost) over folded sections of plans, crew runs and the archive, the project documents and the session's measured costs in folded sections, with the plan-limit thresholds as rulers (used now, the threshold, the room left) and value buttons. Every change goes through a confirmation card; on the desktop a stage starts in a new session of the app, the old conversation kept. One network request only: the Anthropic pricing page, read after "Tak" on a card.

plugins.name: relai-progress
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). RelAI progress above the prompt: segments of the stage in progress or a /relai-crew run with the next item under them, and a button with the session's agents that opens RelAI Agents — each subagent as a role character (owl reviewer, beaver developer, fox analyst and six more) with its task, what it does now, steps, cost and time, every tool step one press away. Reads files only: no model call, no network. Based on savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT); the agents pane inspired by Helper Desk by Ben AI (idea only, no code).

plugins.name: relai-cache-keeper
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.295). Four batteries above the prompt in an even grid — the prompt cache's time left, the 5-hour limit, the time to its reset and the weekly limit — each showing what is left, with the full words in the app's tooltip, and a context row: used / the model's window · %, a notch at the auto-compact threshold (CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE included) and the bar's colour by the way left to it; the session's cost once, on the right; asks before a cold send of a big context and says when a fresh session pays off (/cache shows the reckoning). Plan limits: a 5-hour threshold (90 %) and a weekly one (98 %), each set per session, project or everywhere; past a threshold a card after the turn offers to save the work (tests, a local commit, the docs, a resume file) and, after the reset, Wznów pracę starts a fresh chat from that file. Calls the model only on the person's request (keep-warm pings, hand-off, save and resume).

plugins.name: relai-mods
plugins.description: Needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.308). RelAI Mods: /relai-mods opens a cockpit of the mods, plugins and settings.json hooks on this machine, read from disk in folded groups, each with its scope, version, state and details. A switch turns one plugin on or off through the claude CLI on PATH; Reload reloads the plugins in the terminal and on the desktop asks you to type /reload-plugins. Hooks, policy-managed plugins and the cockpit itself are locked. The row 'RelAI w tym projekcie' above the list turns RelAI and its three add-ons on or off in the session folder (claude plugin --scope local, after a Yes/No card) and adds .claude/settings.local.json to .worktreeinclude, the only file the cockpit writes itself. Never writes settings.json or installed_plugins.json; no model call, no network of its own.

plugins.name: relai-browser
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.321). RelAI Browser: pictures that tools hand to Claude (browser screenshots, Read of an image, MCP images) are shrunk before Claude reads them, so they cost fewer tokens — half the longer side by default, never under 512 px; JPEG stays JPEG (quality 85), the rest becomes PNG; screenshot coordinates are rewritten so clicks still land. Windows (PowerShell + System.Drawing) and macOS (sips); elsewhere pictures pass unchanged. Asks once per RelAI project (row 'Mody oszczędzania' in docs/USTAWIENIA.md) and stays passive in a session with no person before that answer. Sleeps while the BenAI 'efficient-browser-use' mod is on. /relai-browser full lets the next picture through whole; scale, min and pane change the defaults and open the list. Every shrink goes to the RelAI savings ledger (~/.claude/relai/oszczednosci/rejestr/). No model call, no network.

plugins.name: relai-input-router
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.321). RelAI Input Router: a large file (2000 tokens or more), a PDF over 5 pages or the large output of a reader command (cat, head, tail...) is read first by a helper model (claude-haiku-5-5 by default); Claude gets its notes with line numbers and a path to the full text. RelAI process files (docs/, PROMPT_ETAP_*, STATUS.md, PLAN.*, .claude/relai/), instruction files (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, settings), secret files, small ranges, grep/ls/find, builds, tests, git and errors always reach Claude whole. A large MCP connector result (16 000 characters or more) loses its empty fields and short text cuts first; what is still over 8000 characters goes to the helper in chunks. Connectors that drive the app, the browser, sessions, terminals or mods (ccd_*, Claude_Browser, playwright, computer-use, terminal, visualize, scheduled-tasks, mcp-registry, mods) and RelAI's own are never touched. Text with a secret found by the RelAI secret scanner never goes to the helper. Asks once per RelAI project (row 'Mody oszczędzania' in docs/USTAWIENIA.md) and stays passive in a session with no person before that answer. Sleeps while the BenAI 'input-router' mod is on. The hand-off pane (/relai-input-router pane) shows a card per hand-off with tokens before and after, the helper's cost, its notes and the full result, and buttons for the next read whole and the file and connector switches; the command does the same: stats, full, off|on file, off|on connector, model <id>. Notes are remembered by path, time, size and the ask (~/.claude/relai/oszczednosci/input-router/), and every hand-off goes to the RelAI savings ledger.

plugins.name: relai-model-router
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.321). RelAI Model Router: before a subagent starts, a helper model (the judge, haiku, 200 tokens, 8 s at most) reads its task and names the cheapest tier that will do it well — fast, balanced or deep, mapped to the project's RelAI model list (haiku, sonnet, opus by default). Lowering needs confidence 0.6 or more, raising 0.3; a task that may change production, move money or destroy data goes deep. A model the caller named is protected: a different suggestion asks the person by a card (suggestion, mine, always suggestion or always mine in this session); with no person in the session the suggestion applies. For /relai-crew, one card before the crew starts: the tool crew_models judges every task and shows a table (task, your model, suggestion, reason) in the pane 'RelAI crew models' with a pick per row, closed by one card (start with the picks, accept all suggestions, mine for all); a member decided there runs on that model with no second card. The main chat's model is never changed; forks, resumed agents and a mod's own subagents are left alone. A task with a secret found by the RelAI secret scanner never goes to the judge; a judge that fails, times out or answers badly leaves the model as it was and writes why to a file. Asks once per RelAI project (row 'Mody oszczędzania' in docs/USTAWIENIA.md) and stays passive in a session with no person before that answer. Sleeps while the BenAI 'model-router' mod is on. The pane (/relai-model-router pane) shows each choice with its reason and the judge's cost, and the switches; the command does the same: stats, on, off, pane, mine, suggestion, ask. The judge's cost goes to the RelAI savings ledger and is subtracted.

plugins.name: relai-effort
plugins.description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods. RelAI Effort suggests a reasoning effort before a main chat turn using a helper model; a card or auto mode chooses whether to switch. An explicit RelAI stage effort is protected in auto mode. The secret scanner and project consent gate the helper, and an enabled BenAI effort optimizer puts this mod to sleep.
